remarks: Beautifully renovated townhome condo in the heart of New Canaan with 3 Bedrooms, 2.5 Baths and sunny landscaped private patio with storage shed. Finished lower level, laundry room and storage. A few steps from your front door is a private detached 1 car garage, plus 1 assigned spot directly in front of your entrance. Lovely location very close to town center, shopping, restaurants and the Metro-North Train station. Beautiful and spacious white kitchen, stainless steel appliances and windowed breakfast nook for casual dining. Large open concept Living/Dining Room with Wood Burning Fireplace and custom built-ins makes entertaining a joy. Lovely views of the South facing garden patio with beautiful plantings invite you to relax in this peaceful atmosphere. Rich Oak hardwood floors throughout. Lots of storage and easy to maintain. Prides Crossing offers a luxurious setting with private Pool and Clubhouse for an enjoyable lifestyle.
